ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A section of curved long pipe is additionally connected to the water outlet of the metal inner tank of an electric water heater. When the electric water heater leaks electricity and the grounding wire fails, it can form an “electricity-proof wall” to ensure human safety. As shown in the figure, when the water heater leaks electricity and the grounding wire fails, the voltage between its metal inner tank and the earth is 220 V. Since the water in the curved long pipe has resistance (abbreviated as “electricity-isolating resistance”), the voltage across the human body is not higher than 12 V. Which of the following statements is correct ( )
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Multi-Physics open-ended question 1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In order to make the curved long pipe additionally connected to the water outlet of the electric water heater play the role of a "protective electric wall," what electrical conductivity characteristic should the material used to make the curved long pipe have?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: It should be made of a material that does not conduct electricity easily

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the picture, the electric water heater is marked 220 V, indicating that when there is electric leakage, there may be a voltage of 220 V between the metal inner tank and the earth; beside it, a person, the water pipe, and the ground form a possible electric-shock path. Then reason: the question stem states that after a curved long pipe is additionally connected to the water outlet, the water in the pipe has resistance, forming an "electricity-isolating resistance," making the voltage across the human body no higher than the safe value. To make the curved long pipe play the role of a "protective electric wall," the resistance in the leakage path should be increased and the passage of current should be hindered, rather than letting the pipe itself become a good conducting path. Therefore, the curved long pipe should be made of a material with poor electrical conductivity, one that does not conduct electricity easily.
